init_image_transform_dict: create a torchvision transform dictionary with train, val, and test pipelines for image data augmentation and normalization
init_video_transform_dict: create a torchvision transform dictionary with train, val, and test pipelines for video data augmentation and normalization
customize_transform_resolution: build a transform dictionary with a custom input resolution and center crop size for image preprocessing
customize_transform_augmentation: build a transform dictionary with custom random crop scale and color jitter values for data augmentation
customize_transform_normalization: build a transform dictionary with custom normalization mean and standard deviation values for image preprocessing
